mechanism: Methotrexate may decrease haloperidol clearance and increase CNS toxicity risk; both drugs can cause neurotoxicity and impair renal function, compounding methotrexate accumulation.
action: Monitor for signs of haloperidol toxicity (rigidity, tremor, altered mental status); ensure adequate renal function monitoring and consider dose adjustment of haloperidol if used concurrently with high-dose methotrexate.
